n-k-l1f-03.title: Orange sadii, waliigaltee gaarii?
n-k-l1f-03.goal: Falmii bitataa tokkoo mallattoo gatii wajjin qori, gatii wanta tokkoo fi waliigala addaan baasi, gorsa lakkoofsa wajjin kenni.
n-k-l1f-03.material:
Gabaa fuduraa irratti, Jisu fi hiriyaan ishee Minsu mallattoo dubbisu:

[귤]
한 개: 1,000원
세 개: 2,500원

Jisu: 저는 귤 두 개만 필요해요.
Minsu: 세 개에 이천오백 원이에요! 싸요! 세 개 사요!
n-k-l1f-03.thinking.1: Gatii wanta tokkoo fi gatii waliigalaa
n-k-l1f-03.thinking.2: Gorsa fedhii dhugaa nama sanaa wajjin simsiisuu
n-k-l1f-03.prereq.1: 개 fi lakkoofsota Sino-Korean gatiif beeka
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.prompt: Mallattoo dubbisi. Ibsi kamtu mallattoon deeggara?
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.hint.0: Gatii orange tokko tokkoo sadii gatii waciitii sadii wajjin wal bira qabi.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.hint.1: Achiis waliigala orange baay'ina wal fakkaatuu wal bira qabi.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.o.a: Orange sadii orange lama irra laafaa dha.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.r.a: Orange 3 won 2,500 gatii qaba; orange 2 won 2,000 gatii qaba.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.o.b: Orange lama gatii tokkoon gatii waciitii sadii caalaa qaaliidha.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.r.b: 2 x 1,000 = won 2,000, kunis won 2,500 irra laafaa dha.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.o.c: Orange waciitii sadii keessa jiru hundi orange tokko irra laafaa dha.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.o.d: Waciitii sadii orange tokko tokkoo sadii wajjin gatii wal fakkaatu qaba.

n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.prompt: Jisu boruuf orange lama qofa barbaada. Gorsi Minsu '세 개 사요, 싸요!' korojoo ishee tiif gaarii dhaa?
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.hint.0: Orange meeqa Jisu akka barbaachisu barreessi, achiis gatii sirriitti baay'ina sana karaa hundaan herregi.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.hint.1: 'Laafaa' sarara Minsu keessatti orange hundaaf moo waliigalaa gaafadhu.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.o.a: Eeyyee. Orange hundi waciitii keessa laafaa dha, kanaaf waciitiin ishee tiif laafaa dha.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.r.a: Orange hundaaf laafaa ta'uun waliigala laafaa ta'uu miti. Isheen won 2,500 kaffalti, won 2,000 miti.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.o.b: Lakkii. Tokko lama won 2,000 gatii qaba, waciitiin immoo caala.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.o.c: Eeyyee. Won 2,500 won 3,000 irra laafaa dha.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.r.c: Won 3,000 gatii orange tokko sadii dha, isheen garuu orange lama qofa barbaada.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.o.d: Murteessuun hin danda'amu sababni mallattoon orange lamaaf gatii hin qabu.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.r.d: Tokko lama 2 x 1,000 = won 2,000 gatii qaba; mallattoon gahaa dha.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.explain: Orange lamaaf, tokko lama (won 2,000) waciitii (won 2,500) irra laafaa dha. Falmiin Minsu orange hundaaf dhugaa dha, garuu fedhii Jisu wajjin hin simatu.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.prompt: Gorsa himoota 1-2 Jisu tiif barreessi (Afaan Ingiliffaa yookaan Afaan Koreaa). Lakkoofsa mallattoo irraa akka ragaa fayyadami.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.hint.0: Jisu maal akka barbaadu himi, achiis karaa bitachuu hundaaf waliigala kenni.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.hint.1: Karaan kamtu ishee tiif laafaa akka ta'e jedhuun xumuri.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Lakkoofsota lama kenneettaa, 'laafaa dha' qofa osoo hin ta'in?
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Gorsi koo Jisu orange lama akka barbaadu wajjin simataa?
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.model.1: Orange lamaaf, tokko lama bitadhu: won 2,000. Waciitiin sadii won 2,500 dha, kanaaf orange hundi laafaa taatus waliigalatti caalaa gatii qaba.

n-k-l1e-01.title: Maqaa, hojii ... fi biyya?
n-k-l1e-01.goal: Kaardiin of beeksisuu lamaan dhugaa gaaffiin barbaadu akka hin qabne hubadhu, wanti ammas hafe murteessi, Afaan Koreaatiin gaafadhu.
n-k-l1e-01.material:
Guyyaa jalqabaa barnoota. Barsiisaan kaardii of beeksisuu lama (hojii kanaaf uumame) ni qooda.

[카드 1]
안녕하세요? 저는 수진이에요. 학생이에요.

[카드 2]
안녕하세요? 저는 마이클이에요. 선생님이에요.

Barsiisaan kaardii 1 ibsee gaafata: "수진 씨는 한국 사람이에요?"
n-k-l1e-01.prereq.1: 이름, 학생, 선생님, 사람 fi maqaa biyyoota beeka
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.prompt: Barsiisaan gaafata: '수진 씨는 한국 사람이에요?' Kaardii lamaan qofa fayyadamuun deebiin isa gaarii kami?
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hima tokkoon tokkoon kaardii 1 irra maal akka si jedhu tarreessi: maqaa, hojii ... waan biraa jiraa?
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.hint.1: Of gaafadhu: kaardiin jecha biyyaa ykn '-사람' qabaa?
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.o.a: Eeyyee. 수진 maqaa Koreaa dha, kanaaf isheen Koreaa irraa dhufte.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.r.a: Maqaan mallattoo dha, ragaa miti: namoonni biyyoota hedduu irraa maqaa Koreaa qabu, namoonni Koreaas maqaa biraa qabu. Hima maqaa biyyaa kennu barbaadi.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.o.b: Lakki. 학생 jechuun biyya alaatti baratti, kanaaf Koreaa miti.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.r.b: 학생 'barataa' jechuu qofa. Isheen eessaa akka dhufte homaa hin jedhu.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.o.c: Amma miti. Kaardiin maqaa fi hojii ishee kenna, biyya garuu hin kenne.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.o.d: Amma miti. Kaardiin 1 maqaa hin qabu, kanaaf namni tokko illee himuu hin dandeenye.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.r.d: Maqaan kaardii irra jira: 수진. Kutaan hafe adda dha.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.explain: Kaardiin 1 maqaa (수진) fi hojii (학생) kenna garuu biyya yoomiyyuu hin kennu. Kaardiin 2 hin gargaaru: waa'ee 마이클 dha. Deebiin 'amma hin beekamu', dhugaa tokko dabalataa si barbaachisa.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.prompt: 수진 kaardii ishee irratti hima TOKKO dabaltu yaadi. Himoonni dabalaman kam gaaffii barsiisaa murteessu? Hundumaa murteessan filadhu ('eeyyee' ykn 'lakki' lamaan lakkaa'ama).
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.hint.0: Himoota biyya nama tokkoo maqaa kaa'an barbaadi, hobbii ykn qo'annoo miti.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.hint.1: Hima tokkoon tokkoon qori: erga dubbistee booda, mirkanaa'ee 'eeyyee' ykn 'lakki' jechuu dandeessaa?
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.r.a: Namoonni biyyoota hedduu irraa Afaan Koreaa baratu, kanaaf kun biyya ishee hin himu.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.r.d: Bunna jaalachuun biyya wajjin wal-qabate homaa hin qabu.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.explain: Himni '-사람이에요' qabu biyya maqaa kaa'a. 호주 사람 'lakki' deebisa, 한국 사람 'eeyyee' deebisa. Afaan Koreaa baruu ykn bunna jaalachuun hin murteessu.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s3.prompt: Gaaffii kee 수진 dhaaf Afaan Koreaatiin (-요 haasaa ulfina qabeessa) barreessi dhugaa hafe argachuuf.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s3.hint.0: Duraan dhugaan kam hafe murteessi, achiis isa qofa gaafadhu.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Gaaffiin koo dhugaa hafe (biyya) gaafata, kaardii keessa duraanuu jirutti miti?
n-k-l1e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ulfina qabeessa (-요) fi hima tokkoon deebisuuf gabaabaadhaa?

n-k-l1e-02.title: Mallattoo maqaa Rina fi jechoota Rina
n-k-l1e-02.goal: Of beeksisa afaaniin mallattoo maqaa wajjin qori, sarara dhugaan isa dogoggora ta'e tokko argadhu, gosa dogoggoraa maqaa kaa'i, achiis sirreessi.
n-k-l1e-02.material:
Rina keessummaa dha. Isheen mallattoo maqaa uffattee kutaa itti of beeksiti.

[이름표]
이름: 리나
나라: 일본
직업: 선생님

Isheen sarara shan gadii jette.
n-k-l1e-02.thinking.1: Dogoggora seerluga fi dhugaa dogoggoraa addaan baasuu
n-k-l1e-02.prereq.1: 선생님, 학생, 일본 사람 fi -이에요/예요 beeka
n-k-l1e-02.s.s1.prompt: Rina of beeksisa ishee sagalee guddaan dubbistee. Mallattoo maqaa ishee wajjin wal bira qabi. Sarara tokko sirriitti mallattoo hin simanne. Sararri kam?
n-k-l1e-02.s.s1.hint.0: Sarara tokko tokko nagaa dha dhugaa hin qaban. Sarara dhugaa qaban mallatteessi.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s1.hint.1: Mallattoo dhugaa dhugaan fudhadhu (maqaa, biyya, hojii) achiis sarara tokkoon tokkoon jedhu argadhu.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s1.explain: Sarara 4 학생이에요 ('ani barataa dha') jedha, garuu mallattoon 선생님 (barsiisaa) jedha. Afaan Koreaa sarara 4 seerluga gaarii dha; dhugaan dogoggora. Sarara 2 fi 3 mallattoo wajjin wal-simatu, sarara 1 fi 5 nagaa dha dhugaa hin qaban.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.prompt: Dogoggorri sarara ati filatte gosa kam?
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.hint.0: Sarara seerluga qofaan sagalee guddaan dubbisi: seera tokko cabsaa?
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.hint.1: Achiis hiika isaa, bocaa isaa miti, mallattoo wajjin wal bira qabi.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.r.a: Xumurri -이에요 qubee dhumaa waliin birqaba (생) booda sirrii dha. Himni seerlugaan sirrii dha.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.o.b: Seerlugni gaarii dha, garuu dhugaan mallattoo maqaa wajjin wal hin simatu.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.r.c: Xumurri -요 duraanuu ulfina qaba, kanaaf haasaan gaarii dha.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.r.d: 저는 'ani' jechuuf jecha ulfina qabeessa fi wal-argii jalqabaaf mijaa'a; 나는 laafaa ta'a.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.explain: Sararri Afaan Koreaa sirrii ta'ee haala sanaaf dogoggora ta'uu danda'a. Asitti himni gaarii dha, garuu mallattoo wajjin wal hin simatu.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s3.prompt: Sarara dogoggora Afaan Koreaatiin deebi'ii barreessi akka mallattoo maqaa wajjin wal-simatu. Haasaa ulfina qabeessa -요 eegi.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s3.hint.0: Jecha hojii sirrii mallattoo irraa bocaa hima wal-fakkaatu keessa kaa'i.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s3.hint.1: Xumura ilaali: jechi hojii dubbifamaa moo dubbachiiftuu irratti xumurama?
n-k-l1e-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Sararri koo hojii mallattoo irra jiru jedhaa?

n-k-l1e-03.title: Jecha tokko, taatee sadii
n-k-l1e-03.goal: Jecha Koriyaa wal-fakkaataa haala guddachaa jiru sadii keessatti dubbisi, haalli yeroo jijjiiramu hiika isaa fooyyessi, maaltu murteesse jedhi, fi ofiin sirriitti fayyadami.
n-k-l1e-03.material: Haala gabaabaa sadii hiriyoota kutaa 하나 fi 민수 gidduu (uumame). Isaan haasaa ulfinaa -요 fayyadamu. Haalli tokko tokkoon yeroo tokkotti agarsiifama.
n-k-l1e-03.prereq.1: 고마워요, 죄송해요 fi 선생님 ni beeka
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.prompt: Jechi wal-fakkaataan haalawwan xixiqqoo sadii keessatti mul'ata. Haala tokko tokkoo dubbisi fi isa itti aanu osoo hin argin asitti hiika isaa murteessi.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.hint.0: Osoo hin filatin dura sarara jecha sana dura jiru dubbisi.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.hint.1: Gaafadhu nama kaan ammuma maal godhe: gaafate, galateeffate, ykn dhiifama gaafate?
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.info:
Haala 1. 하나 hiriyaa ishee 민수 waliin beeksiti.

하나: 민수 씨, 이 사람은 지우 씨예요.
민수: 지우 씨는 선생님이에요?
하나: 아니에요.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: 아니에요 하나 asitti maal jechuu dha?
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Gaaffii eyyee/lakkii deebisuun, 아니에요 'lakkii' jechuu dha.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Namni tokko illee ishee hin galateeffanne, kanaaf 'baga nagaan dhufte' jechuuf sababni hin jiru.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Haala kana keessatti namni tokko illee dogoggora hin goone.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Asitti dhiifamuu barbaachisu hin jiru; 민수 gaaffii gaafate.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.info:
Haala 2. Booda, 민수 qalama 하나 liqeessa.

하나: 고마워요!
민수: 아니에요.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: 아니에요 민수 amma maal jechuu dha?
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.after: 고마워요 booda, 아니에요 deebii of-gadi-qabu dha: 'Homaa miti.' Jechi wal-fakkaataan amma galata deebisa, gaaffii miti.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Inni qalama dhiyeessaa jira. Kun jecha akkuma Haala 1 keessatti dubbisa fi wanta 하나 ammuma jette dhiisa.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Homaa hin turre; baga nagaan dhufte.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Namni tokko illee eenyu akka ta'e hin gaafanne.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Inni dhiifama gaafachuu barbaachisu hin qabu.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.info:
Haala 3. Karaa keessa 민수 irree 하나 tuqa.

민수: 죄송해요!
하나: 아니에요.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Dhiifama booda, 아니에요 'Sirrii dha, hin yaadda'in' jechuu dha. Jecha tokko, hojii sadii: sararri isa dura jiru murteessa.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Haala keessatti homtuu isheen isa shakkiti hin jedhu; dhiifama booda jechi jajjabeessa.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Namni tokko illee isheen eenyu akka taate hin gaafanne.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Inni ishee hin galateeffanne; dhiifama gaafate.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.reflect: Dubbisni kee 아니에요 haala irraa gara haala jijjiirameeraa? Yeroo hundaa murteessuuf maal ilaalte?
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.prompt: Haalawwan sadan deebi'ii yeroo ilaaltu, maaltu yeroo hundaa hiika 아니에요 murteesse?
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.hint.0: Haalawwan sadan keessatti wanta hafe fi wanta jijjiirame wal-bira qabi.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.hint.1: Yeroo hundaa wanta jecha sana dura battalumaan dhufe ilaali.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.r.a: Jechi yeroo hundaa wal-fakkaataa ture, kanaaf hiika kan jijjiire ta'uu hin danda'u.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.o.b: Sarara battalumaan isa dura dubbifame, fi wanta ammuma ta'e.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.o.c: Dubbataan dhiira moo dhalaa ta'uu isaa.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.r.c: Dhiironnii fi dubartoonni lamaanuu jecha karaa sadanuu fayyadamu.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.o.d: Jechi sagalee hangam ol ta'een jedhame.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.r.d: Hojiin kun waa'ee barreeffama dha; hiikni asitti jechoota dura jiran irraa dhufa.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.explain: Jechi gonkumaa hin jijjiiramne. Hiikni sarara duraa irraa dhufe: gaaffii (lakkii), galata (homaa miti), ykn dhiifama (sirrii dha).
n-k-l1e-03.s.s3.prompt: Hiriyaan kutaa '고마워요!' siin jedha sababni qalama liqeessiteef. Afaan Koriyaatiin (haasaa ulfinaa -요) deebii of-gadi-qabu 'Homaa miti' jedhi.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s3.hint.0: Sarara 고마워요 booda Haala 2 keessatti argite yaadadhu.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s3.hint.1: Xumura ulfinaa (-요) eegi; deebii gabaabaan sirrii dha.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Deebiin koo gargaarsa xiqqeessa galata irra deebi'ee jechuu mannaa?

n-k-l1e-04.title: Eenyutu xiqqaa dha? Wal-bira qabiinsa qofa
n-k-l1e-04.goal: Of-beeksisa idilee afur umurii wal-bira qabuu qofa gara seeraatti jijjiiri, ijaarsa umurii sirrii hedduu ijaari, ulfinaan tokko waliin nagaa jedhi, fi wanta hundumaa keessatti dhugaa ta'e argi.
n-k-l1e-04.material:
Namoonni afur kutaa Koriyaa keessatti wal-argu (hundi uumame). 민아 umurii ishee jetti. Kaan wal-bira qabu qofa.

민아: 저는 20살이에요.
하나: 저는 민아 씨보다 어려요. 지호 씨보다 나이가 많아요.
선생님: 저는 민아 씨보다 나이가 많아요.
(지호 waa'ee umurii homaa hin jedhu.)

Jechoota: 어려요 = xiqqaa dha; 나이가 많아요 = guddaa dha; A보다 = A caalaa.
n-k-l1e-04.thinking.2: Wanti dhimma hundumaa keessatti dhugaa ta'e
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.prompt: Hana: '저는 민아 씨보다 어려요.' jetti. Kun waa'ee Hana maal siif hima?
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.hint.0: Hima keessatti 보다 argi fi namoota kamtu lamaan akka walitti hidhu ilaali.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.hint.1: Hima ishee keessatti lakkoofsi tokko jiraachuu isaa gaafadhu.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.o.a: Hana 19 dha, kanaaf 민아 caalaa waggaa tokko xiqqaa dha.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.r.a: Himni 'xiqqaa' jedha garuu lakkoofsa hin kennu. 19 umurii danda'amoo hedduu keessaa tokko qofa dha.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.o.b: Hana 민아 caalaa xiqqaa dha; himni lakkoofsa hin kennu.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.r.c: 어려요 'xiqqaa' jechuu dha. -보다 'caalaa' jechuu dha, kanaaf Hana xiqqaa dha, guddaa miti.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.o.d: Hana fi 민아 umurii wal-fakkaataa qabu.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.r.d: Umurii wal-fakkaataa yoo qabaatan, namni tokko illee '어려요' hin jedhu.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.explain: '-보다 어려요' wal-bira qabiinsa kaa'a, lakkoofsa miti. Umuriin hedduun simata.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.prompt: Nama hundi kutaa keessa 10 fi 60 gidduu dha. 민아 20 dha. Fakkeenya adda addaa 3 ijaari (j = 지호, h = 하나, t = 선생님) kanneen hima hundi dhugaa ta'u, fi tokko tokkoon umurii 하나 adda fayyadami.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.hint.0: Dura namoota afran xiqqaa irraa gara guddaatti tartiibaan kaa'i.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.hint.1: Umurii 하나 filadhu, ergasii 지호 xiqqaa fi 선생님 guddaa filadhu.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.hint.2: Hima Koriyaa tokko tokkoon lakkoofsa kee waliin mirkaneessi.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Kutaa keessa nama tokko illee umurii 10 gadi ykn 60 ol hin qabu.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.fail.c2: 하나 민아, kan umurii 20, caalaa xiqqaa dha jetti.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.fail.c3: 하나 지호 caalaa guddaa dha jetti.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.fail.c4: 선생님 inni ykn isheen 민아, kan umurii 20, caalaa guddaa dha jedha.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.explain: Himoonni wal-bira qabiinsa qofa kennu, kanaaf umuriin hedduun simata: fakkeenyaaf 12 < 15 < 20 < 35. Lakkoofsi tartiiba sirriitti jiru kamiyyuu hojjeta.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Fakkeenya kee keessaa tokko filadhu. Afaan Koriyaatiin 지호 yeroo jalqabaaf 선생님 wal-argee maal akka jedhu barreessi: nagaa ulfinaa fi umurii isaa.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nagaa guyyaa jalqabaa kutaa irraa beektu tiin jalqabi.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Lakkoofsa 지호 kee + 살 umurii tiif fayyadami.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Umuriin ani barreesse lakkoofsa 지호 fakkeenya kootii waliin simataa?
n-k-l1e-04.s.s3.prompt: Dubbiin kamtu fakkeenya sirrii HUNDUMAA keessatti dhugaa dha, kee qofa miti?
n-k-l1e-04.s.s3.hint.0: Fakkeenya kee sadan cinaa cinaan barreessi fi wanta gonkumaa hin jijjiiramne ilaali.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s3.hint.1: Walitti hidhama nama xiqqaa irraa gara guddaatti hordofi.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s3.o.a: 하나 민아 caalaa waggaa lama xiqqaa dha.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s3.r.a: Himoonni 하나 xiqqaa dha jedhu qofa. Fakkeenya kee keessatti garaagarummaan jijjiirama (15, 18, 19 ...).
n-k-l1e-04.s.s3.o.b: 선생님 민아 caalaa waggaa 10 guddaa dha.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s3.r.b: Himoonni 선생님 민아 caalaa guddaa dha jedhu garuu waggaa meeqa akka ta'e gonkumaa hin jedhan.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s3.r.d: Hima 하나 irra deebi'ii ilaali: 지호 lamaan keessaa isa xiqqaa dha.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s3.explain: 지호 < 하나 < 민아 (20) < 선생님, kanaaf 선생님 fakkeenya hundumaa keessatti 지호 caalaa guddaa dha, hima tokko illee kallattiin hin jedhin yoo ta'e illee.

n-k-l1f-01.title: Kuusaa nyaata guyyaa ajajuu dandeenyaa?
n-k-l1f-01.topic: Nyaata ajajuu: menu haala dhoksame qabu
n-k-l1f-01.goal: Mallattoo menu gabaabaa dubbisi, dhugaa ajajni danda'amuu moo hin danda'amne murteessu filadhu, dhimma dhugaa irratti fayyadami, fi hojjettaa waa'ee wanta amma illee jiru gaaffii ulfinaa gaafadhu.
n-k-l1f-01.material:
Balbala mana nyaataa irratti mallattoo kana dubbista. Kuusaan nyaata guyyaa Koriyaa addaa dha.

[점심 세트]
김치찌개 세트: 8,000원 (밥, 김치찌개, 음료)
시간: 12시 ~ 2시
두 명부터 주문해요.
n-k-l1f-01.thinking.0: Odeeffannoo barbaachisaa fi hin barbaachisne adda baasuu
n-k-l1f-01.thinking.1: Haalawwan hundi yeroo tokko guutamuu isaanii mirkaneessuu
n-k-l1f-01.prereq.1: Lakkoofsa + 시, 분 fi 명 ni beeka
n-k-l1f-01.prereq.2: Mallattoo irraa 주문 fi 세트 ni beeka
n-k-l1f-01.s.s1.prompt: Ati fi hiriyaan kee nyaata guyyaa 김치찌개 세트 nyaachuu barbaaddu. Osoo hin ba'in, dhugaa kamtu mallattoo waliin mirkaneessuu qabdu ajaja kennuu dandeessan moo hin dandeenye beekuuf? Hunda isaan simatan filadhu.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s1.hint.0: Mallattoo sarara tokko tokkoon dubbisi. Sarara seera ajajuu kaa'u hunda mallatteessi, fi sarara gatii ykn meeshaa tarreessu qofa dhiisi.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s1.hint.1: Filannoo tokko tokkoof gaafadhu: mallattoon waa'ee isaa seera qabaa?
n-k-l1f-01.s.s1.r.a: Gatiin mallattoo irratti maxxanfameera, garuu eenyutu yeroo kam ajajuu akka danda'u hin daangessu.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s1.o.b: Wanta kuusaa waliin dhufu (밥, 김치찌개, 음료)
n-k-l1f-01.s.s1.r.b: Kun wanta ati argattu siif hima. Seera ajajuu miti.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s1.r.d: Mallattoon guyyaa tokkoyyuu maqaa hin kennu.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s1.explain: Mallattoon haalawwan lama kaa'a: yeroo (12 hanga 2) fi baay'ina garee (nama lama yookaan isaa ol). Dhugaatiin, maallaqni fi teessumni haala miti.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s2.prompt: Ati fi hiriyaan tokko mana nyaataa sa'aa 두 시 십 분 (2:10) ga'a. 김치찌개 세트 ajajuu dandeessaa?
n-k-l1f-01.s.s2.hint.0: Haalawwan lamaan tokko tokkoon mirkaneessi, hundaaf 'eeyyee' yookaan 'lakkii' barreessi.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s2.hint.1: 두 시 십 분 yeroo mallattoo irratti barreeffame wajjin wal bira qabi.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s2.o.a: Eeyyee. Namoonni lama, kanaaf haalli garee guutameera.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s2.r.a: Haalawwan lamaanuu guutamuu qabu. Yeroo illee mirkaneessi.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s2.o.b: Lakkii. Namoonni lama, garuu yeroon sirna sa'aa 2:00 tti xumurame.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s2.o.c: Lakkii. Nama tokkoof qofa dha, ati immoo lama.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s2.r.c: Mallattoon faallaa jedha: namoota lama yookaan isaa olii dha.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s2.o.d: Eeyyee. Sirna laaqanaa yeroo baay'ee daqiiqaa muraasa dheeraatti deema, kanaaf ammayyuu ajajuu dandeessa.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s2.r.d: Mallattoon sa'aa 2 xumura kenna. Yeroo dabalataa hin tilmaamin.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s2.explain: Haalli garee guutameera (namoota lama), haalli yeroo garuu hin guutamne: mallattoon 12:00 hanga 2:00 jedha, amma 2:10 dha. Seerri lamaanuu guutamuu qaba.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s3.prompt: Yeroon sirna xumurameera. Gurgurtichaa Afaan Koreaatiin kabajaan gaafadhu (gaaffii gabaabaa tokko): amma maal ajajuu dandeessa, yookaan menu biraa jiraa?
n-k-l1f-01.s.s3.hint.0: Wanta amma argamu gaafadhu, -요? tiin xumuri.
n-k-l1f-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Amma maal ajajuu akka dandeessu yookaan menu biraa gaafataa?

n-k-l1f-02.title: Waciitii shan waajjiraaf
n-k-l1f-02.goal: Ergaa gabaabaa gara haalawwan sirrii jijjiiri, ajajawwan hedduu hunda guutan argadhu, achiis tokko Afaan Koreaatiin gabaasi.
n-k-l1f-02.material:
Hiriyaan kee kaafeen deemuu dura ergaa si erga:

"커피도 주스도 사 와요. 모두 다섯 잔이에요. 돈은 만 삼천 원 있어요."

Jechoota: 커피도 주스도 = bunni fi jiisii lamaanuu (tokko tokko); 모두 = walitti; 돈 = maallaqa; 있어요 = qabda.

[가격표]
커피 한 잔: 3,000원
주스 한 잔: 2,000원
n-k-l1f-02.thinking.0: 모두 fi 커피도 주스도 sirriitti dubbisuu
n-k-l1f-02.prereq.2: 모두 fi 커피도 주스도 (ergaa jalatti hiikame) beeka
n-k-l1f-02.s.s1.prompt: '모두 다섯 잔이에요' ergaa hiriyaa kee keessatti maal jechuu dha?
n-k-l1f-02.s.s1.hint.0: 모두 maal akka lakkaa'u ilaali: dhugaatii hundaa adda addaan moo hundumaa yeroo tokko?
n-k-l1f-02.s.s1.hint.1: Wanta mana fidu lakkaa'i, dhugaatii tokko tokkoon adda addaan miti.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s1.o.a: Waciitii bunaa shan fi waciitii jiisii shan
n-k-l1f-02.s.s1.r.a: '모두' asitti hunda walitti lakkaa'a; lakkoofsi adda ba'e jechoota akka '각각' yookaan '다섯 잔씩' barbaada.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s1.o.b: Waciitii shan waliigalatti, bunni fi jiisiin waliin
n-k-l1f-02.s.s1.r.d: '이에요' lakkoofsa jedha; 'yookaan isaa ol' hin jedhu.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s1.explain: '모두' 'walitti' jechuu dha. Waciitii bunaa fi waciitii jiisii waliin shan dha.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.prompt: Ajaja adda addaa 3 wanta ergaa keessa jiru hunda guutan argadhu. c = waciitii bunaa, j = waciitii jiisii.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.hint.0: Dura haalawwan jechoota mataa keetiin tarreessi, sarara tokko tokkoon.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.hint.1: c = 1 irraa jalqabi, j argadhu akka waciitiin walitti dabalamu waliigala ta'u; achiis c = 2 yaali, kkf.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.hint.2: Maallaqa dhumarratti mirkaneessi: 3,000 x c + 2,000 x j. Ammayyuu wanta qabdu keessa jira?
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.fail.c2: 모두 다섯 잔이에요: waciitiin sirriitti shan dabalama.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.explain: Bunaa 1 + jiisii 4 = won 11,000; 2 + 3 = won 12,000; 3 + 2 = won 13,000. Hundi won 13,000 keessa jira. Bunaa 4 + jiisii 1 = won 14,000 baayyee dha. Maallaqni daangaa dha, gatii kaffaltu miti.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Ajaja kee TOKKO filadhu, hiriyaa kee Afaan Koreaatiin (kabajaa -요) ergi: waciitii hundaa meeqa ajajte fi gatii waliigalaa.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sarara kee tokko fayyadami: lakkoofsota kamtu lama?
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Baay'ina bunaa, baay'ina jiisii, achiis waliigala won tiin himi.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Lakkoofsonni koo ajaja ijaare tokko wajjin simatuu?

n-k-l1f-04.title: Lakkoofsi kamtu kam wajjin deema?
n-k-l1f-04.topic: Nyaata ajajuu: jechoota lakkaa'uu fi maallaqa
n-k-l1f-04.goal: Dogoggora lakkoofsaa haasaa ajajaa keessatti argadhu, maaliif lakkoofsonni kufan jedhi, sirreessi.
n-k-l1f-04.material: Kaafee snack tokko. Menuun: 토스트 한 개 2,000원, 주스 한 잔 2,000원. Maamilli tokko toost tokko fi jiisii sadii ajaja.
n-k-l1f-04.thinking.0: Fakkeenya (sararoota gurgurtichaa) fayyadamuun kan mataa ofii mirkaneessuu
n-k-l1f-04.prereq.1: Lakkoofsota uumamaa (한, 두, 세) fi Sino-Korean (일, 이, 삼) beeka
n-k-l1f-04.s.s1.prompt: Maamilli kun yeroo ajajuu fi kaffaluu lakkoofsota irratti dogoggora hojjata. Sarara dogoggora lakkoofsaa qabu tokko filadhu.

Sararri 7 ('여덟 천 원') lakkoofsa uumamaa maallaqa wajjin fayyadama; maallaqni lakkoofsa Sino-Korean fayyadama: 팔천 원. (Sararoonni 4 fi 6 gurgurtichaa bocawwan sirrii agarsiisu.)
n-k-l1f-04.s.s2.prompt: Sarara '주스는 삼 잔 주세요' keessatti, sirriitti maaltu dogoggora?
n-k-l1f-04.s.s2.hint.0: Lakkoofsa gurgurtichi 잔 dura fayyadamu lakkoofsa maamilaa wajjin wal bira qabi.
n-k-l1f-04.s.s2.hint.1: Sirna lakkoofsaa 원 f fayyadamtu kam akka ta'e yaadi.
n-k-l1f-04.s.s2.o.a: 주스 잔 tiin lakkaa'amuu hin danda'u; 개 jechuu qaba.
n-k-l1f-04.s.s2.r.a: 잔 lakkaa'aa sirrii dhugaatii waciitii keessaati.
n-k-l1f-04.s.s2.r.b: 주세요 wanta kadhachuuf sirriitti sirrii dha.
n-k-l1f-04.s.s2.o.c: Waciitii lakkaa'uun lakkoofsa uumamaa (한, 두, 세, 네) fayyadama, 삼 immoo lakkoofsa Sino-Korean dha.
n-k-l1f-04.s.s2.o.d: 삼 baayyee idilee dha; 세 bocaa kabajaa isaa qofa.
n-k-l1f-04.s.s2.r.d: Garaagarummaan kabajaa miti. Afaan Koreaa sirna lakkoofsaa lama qaba.
n-k-l1f-04.s.s2.explain: Afaan Koreaa sirna lakkoofsaa lama qaba. Wantoota 개, 잔, 명 tiin lakkaa'aman lakkoofsa uumamaa (한, 두, 세, 네...) fayyadamu. Maallaqni, daqiiqaan fi guyyaan lakkoofsa Sino-Korean (일, 이, 삼...) fayyadamu.
n-k-l1f-04.s.s3.prompt: Sararoota dogoggoraa lamaan sirriitti deebi'ii barreessi: '주스는 삼 잔 주세요.' fi '여기 여덟 천 원 있어요.'
n-k-l1f-04.s.s3.hint.0: Sarara waciitii dura sirreessi: jecha lakkoofsaa kamtu 잔 dura dhufa?
n-k-l1f-04.s.s3.hint.1: Achiis 8,000 sirna lakkoofsaa maallaqaaf fayyadamtu tiin himi.

n-k-l1g-01.title: Asii, achi, fagoo achi: iddoon eenyuu?
n-k-l1g-01.goal: Iddoon 여기 fi 거기 kan eenyuu akka agarsiisan hubadhu, maaliif barreeffamni 여기 qabu dubbisaa dhabsiisuu akka danda'u ilaali, maqaa iddoo dhugaa wajjin deebi'ii barreessi.

n-k-l1g-05.material:
Mallattoo buufata baaburaa fuuldura hospitaalaa:

10번 버스
월~금  06:00 ~ 22:00
토  08:00 ~ 20:00
일  없어요

(월~금 = Wiixata hanga Jimaata.) Hiriyyoonni afur waa'ee baaburaa 10 haasa'u.
n-k-l1g-05.thinking.1: Falmii ragaa (mallattoo) wajjin guyyaa guyyaan simsiisuu
n-k-l1g-05.prereq.1: Guyyoota torbanii, 버스, 있어요/없어요, sa'aatii lakkoofsaan beeka
n-k-l1g-05.s.s1.prompt: Himoota hiriyyoota kam mallattoon deeggara? Hunda filadhu.
n-k-l1g-05.s.s1.hint.0: Himicha hundaa sarara mallattoo guyyaa sanaa wajjin qori.
n-k-l1g-05.s.s1.hint.1: Yeroo tokkoof, yeroo jalqabaa fi xumura sarara sanaa wajjin wal bira qabi. Yaadadhu 아침 여섯 시 = 06:00 fi 저녁 아홉 시 = 21:00.
n-k-l1g-05.s.s1.r.a: Mallattoon 일 없어요 jedha, kanaaf Dilbata baaburri hin jiru.
n-k-l1g-05.s.s1.explain: 수지 sirrii dha (Dilbata: 없어요). 준 sirrii dha (Roobii 21:00 06:00 fi 22:00 gidduu dha). 민수 yaada 매일 isaa Dilbata cabsa, 하나 immoo Sanbataaf yeroo jalqabaa guyyaa hojii fayyadama.
n-k-l1g-05.s.s2.prompt: Sanbata ganama 7:00 dha (아침 일곱 시). Jun hospitaalaaf baaburaa 10 fudhachuu barbaada. Maal gochuu qaba?
n-k-l1g-05.s.s2.hint.1: 07:00 yeroo jalqabaa sarara sanaa wajjin wal bira qabi.
n-k-l1g-05.s.s2.o.a: Amma fudhadhu, sababni isaa baaburri 06:00 irraa jalqaba
n-k-l1g-05.s.s2.r.a: 06:00 jalqaba guyyaa hojii dha. Sanbata yeroo mataa isaa qaba.
n-k-l1g-05.s.s2.o.b: Karaa biraa fayyadami, sababni isaa har'a baaburri hin jiru
n-k-l1g-05.s.s2.o.c: Wiixata hanga eegi, sababni isaa dhuma torbanii baaburri hin deemu
n-k-l1g-05.s.s2.o.d: Sa'aatii tokko eegi, sababni isaa baaburri Sanbataa 08:00 irraa jalqaba
n-k-l1g-05.s.s2.explain: Sararri Sanbataa 08:00 ~ 20:00 jedha, kanaaf 07:00 irratti baaburri ammallee hin jiru, garuu sa'aatii tokko booda ni jiraata.
n-k-l1g-05.s.s3.prompt: 민수 jedhe: '십 번 버스는 매일 있어요.' Himicha Afaan Koreaa (-요 ulfaataa) tokko isa sirreessu barreessi.
n-k-l1g-05.s.s3.hint.0: Sarara mallattoo '매일' wajjin hin simannee argi.
n-k-l1g-05.s.s3.hint.1: Guyyaa sana maqaa kenni, 없어요 fayyadami.
n-k-l1g-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Himni koo guyyaa falmii isaa cabsu jedhaa?
n-k-l1g-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Himni koo mallattoo wajjin dhugaa dha?

n-k-l1h-01.title: Falmii Sora waa'ee ganama Minsu
n-k-l1h-01.goal: Falmii gabaabaa waa'ee sagantaa torbanii yaadannoo irraa dhufe wajjin mirkaneessi, himicha ragaa dhugaa argi, falmii sana guyyoota fi yeroo wal simatan wajjin sirreessi.
n-k-l1h-01.material:
Minsu waa'ee torban isaa kutaa Afaan Koreaa isaatiif barreesse. Hiriyyaan kutaa isaa Sora dubbiste, falmii tokko godhe.

민수의 일주일
월요일부터 금요일까지 학교에 가요.
그래서 아침 여섯 시에 일어나요.
토요일과 일요일에는 열 시에 일어나요.
그리고 저녁 열한 시에 자요.

소라: 민수는 매일 여섯 시에 일어나요.
n-k-l1h-01.thinking.0: Falmii waliigalaa ('guyyaa hundaa') ragaa wajjin qorachuu
n-k-l1h-01.thinking.2: Yeroo tokkoon tokkoon isaa guyyoota sirrii wajjin eegu
n-k-l1h-01.prereq.1: Guyyoota torbanii, 시 lakkoofsa uumamaa wajjin, fi -아요/어요 beeka
n-k-l1h-01.prereq.2: 매일 (guyyaa hundaa) beeka; hubachiisa keessatti ibsameera
n-k-l1h-01.s.s1.prompt: Yaadannoon Minsu falmii Sora deeggaraa? (매일 = guyyaa hundaa)
n-k-l1h-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tarree xiqqoo tolchi: himni tokkoon tokkoon isaa guyyoota kam waa'ee dubbata?
n-k-l1h-01.s.s1.hint.1: Yeroo Sora yeroo yaadannoo keessatti argitu hunda bira kaa'i.
n-k-l1h-01.s.s1.hint.2: Gaafadhu: guyyaan tokko yeroo adda yoo qabaate, '매일' ammallee dhugaa ta'aa?
n-k-l1h-01.s.s1.o.a: Eeyyee. Yaadannoon ja'a irratti ka'a jedha, yaadannoon sunis waa'ee torban isaa dha.
n-k-l1h-01.s.s1.r.a: Yaadannoon waa'ee torban isaa guutuu dha, garuu yeroo tokko ol kenna. Falmiin guyyaa hundaa guyyaa hundi akka wal simatu barbaada.
n-k-l1h-01.s.s1.o.b: Lakki. Yaadannoon guyyoota garaagaraaf yeroo ka'uu lama garaagara kenna.
n-k-l1h-01.s.s1.o.c: Eeyyee. 그래서 ja'a seera isaa torban guutuuf akka ta'e agarsiisa.
n-k-l1h-01.s.s1.r.c: 그래서 sababa ja'aaf (mana barumsaa) kenna, kanaaf guyyoota mana barumsaa qaban qofa haguuga.
n-k-l1h-01.s.s1.o.d: Himuu hin dandeenyu. Yaadannoon Sanbataa fi Dilbata waa'ee homaa hin jedhu.
n-k-l1h-01.s.s1.r.d: Yaadannoon waa'ee Sanbataa fi Dilbata wanta jedha: himichi kam maqaa isaanii kenna ilaali.
n-k-l1h-01.s.s1.explain: Yaadannoon garee guyyoota lama maqaa kenna: Wiixata hanga Jimaata (ja'a, sababa mana barumsaatiin) fi Sanbata fi Dilbata (kudhan). 'Guyyaa hundaa ja'aa' garee jalqabaa qofa wajjin simata.
n-k-l1h-01.s.s2.prompt: Himni yaadannoo kam ragaa cimaa falmii Sora faallessu?
n-k-l1h-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ragaan falmii faallessu falmii irraa adda ta'e dubbachuu qaba.
n-k-l1h-01.s.s2.hint.1: Himicha guyyoota biroo irratti ka'uu (일어나요) dubbatu barbaadi.
n-k-l1h-01.s.s2.r.a: Himni kun guyyoota mana barumsaa maqaa kenna, garuu 'ja'a' faallessu homaa hin jedhu. Sababa himicha itti aanuu dha.
n-k-l1h-01.s.s2.r.b: Himni kun Wiixata hanga Jimaataa Sora deeggara. Ragaan falmii faallessu yeroo adda agarsiisuu qaba.
n-k-l1h-01.s.s2.r.d: Rafuu amala adda dha. Yeroo ka'u hin jijjiiru.
n-k-l1h-01.s.s2.explain: Himni kun qofa guyyoota biroo yeroo ka'uu adda (kudhan) wajjin maqaa kenna. Falmiin 'guyyaa hundaa' guyyaan tokko yeroo adda yoo qabaate kufa.
n-k-l1h-01.s.s3.prompt: Himicha Sora yaadannoo wajjin akka simatu deebisii barreessi. Guyyoonni yeroo kam wajjin akka deeman himi. Afaan Koreaatiin barreessi (Ingliffaan illee fudhatama).
n-k-l1h-01.s.s3.hint.0: Himni kee kutaa lama barbaada, garee guyyoota tokkoon tokkoon isaaf tokko.
n-k-l1h-01.s.s3.hint.1: Yaadannoo deebisii ilaali: yeroon kam Wiixata hanga Jimaataa, kam immoo Sanbataa fi Dilbataa?
n-k-l1h-01.s.s3.hint.2: Xumura yaadannoo wajjin wal fakkaatu fayyadami (-아요/어요).
n-k-l1h-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Himni koo garee guyyoota lama kennaa?
n-k-l1h-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Yeroon tokkoon tokkoon isaa guyyoota sirrii wajjin jiraa (ja'a guyyoota mana barumsaa, kudhan dhuma torbanii)?
n-k-l1h-01.s.s3.model.2: Guyyoota hojii irratti sa'aatii 6 irratti ka'a, Sanbataa fi Dilbata irratti immoo sa'aatii 10.

n-k-l1h-02.title: Dayarii Hana: yoom raawwate?
n-k-l1h-02.goal: Himoota dayarii jecha yeroo fi xumura gochaa yeroo garaagara agarsiisan argi, wanta dogoggora ta'e himi, himicha tokko karaa lamaan sirreessi.
n-k-l1h-02.material:
Hana ganama Roobii dayarii gabaabaa barreessiti. Himoota ishee keessaa lama jecha yeroo xumura gochaa wajjin hin simanne qabu.

(Roobii = 수요일, kaleessa = 어제, har'a = 오늘, bor = 내일)
n-k-l1h-02.thinking.0: Jechoota yeroo fi xumura gochaa wal simsiisuu (darbe, amma, fuulduraa)
n-k-l1h-02.prereq.2: -았어요/-었어요 (darbe) fi -(으)ㄹ 거예요 (fuulduraa) argeera; hubachiisa keessatti ibsameera
n-k-l1h-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarara jecha yeroo fi xumura gochaa yeroo garaagara agarsiisan tokko filadhu.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s1.hint.0: Sarara hundaa dubbisi, yoom akka raawwate himi: har'a duraa, har'a, ykn har'a booda.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s1.hint.1: Jecha yeroo sararaa, ergasii xumura gochaa ilaali: -았어요/-었어요 = ammuma raawwateera, -ㄹ 거예요 = ammallee hin raawwatamne.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s1.hint.2: Mallattoo lamaan sarara hundaa keessatti wal bira qabi. Wal simu?
n-k-l1h-02.s.s1.explain: Sararoonni 3 fi 5. Sarara 3 keessatti 어제 (kaleessa) 만날 거예요 (fuulduraa) wajjin deema. Sarara 5 keessatti 내일 (bor) 갔어요 (darbe) wajjin deema. Sarara 4 gaarii dha: karoora har'a booda tiif Afaan Koreaan yeroo baayyee amma salphaa (-아요/어요) fayyadama, sarara 6 immoo fuulduraa kaayyoodhaan fayyadama.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.prompt: Sarara 3 ilaali: '어제 친구를 만날 거예요.' Maaliif dogoggora?
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.hint.0: Mallattoo fi bifa gochaa mataa isaanii qori: gaarii dhaa?
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ergasii gaafadhu 어제 waa'ee yeroo maal akka jedhu, -ㄹ 거예요 immoo maal akka jedhu.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.o.a: 친구를 친구가 ta'uu qaba, sababni isaa hiriyyaan nama wal argu dha.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.r.a: Mallattoon 를 wanta wal argamu (hiriyyaa) mallatteessa. Wal-hin-simannaan bakka biraa jira.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.o.b: 어제 에 barbaada, kanaaf 어제에 ta'uu qaba.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.r.b: Jechoonni akka 어제, 오늘, 내일 asitti 에 hin barbaadan. Wal-hin-simannaan bakka biraa jira.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.o.c: 어제 darbe agarsiisa, garuu -ㄹ 거예요 fuulduraa agarsiisa.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.o.d: 만날 거예요 bifa dogoggoraa dha, sababni 만나다 -ㄹ 거예요 fudhachuu hin dandeenyeef.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.r.d: -ㄹ 거예요 gocha kana booda dhufuu danda'a; bifni sirrii dha. Wal hin simuun bakka biraa jira.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.explain: Mallattoowwan lamaan wal hin simatan: kaleessa (darbe) fi 'nan wal-arga' (egeree). Kutaaleen lamaanuu kophaa isaaniitti sirrii ta'uu danda'u, garuu hima tokko keessatti miti.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s3.prompt: Sarara 5 sirreessi: '내일 도서관에 갔어요.' Hima waa'ee mana kitaabaa deemuu eegi. Gocha ykn jecha yeroo jijjiiruu dandeessa. Hima haaraa barreessi.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s3.hint.0: Dura murteessi: daawwannaan mana kitaabaa egeree moo darbe akka ta'u barbaaddaa?
n-k-l1h-02.s.s3.hint.1: Jecha yeroo eegi fi xumura jijjiiri, ykn xumura eegi fi jecha yeroo jijjiiri.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s3.hint.2: Darbe: -았어요/-었어요. Egeree: -ㄹ 거예요 (ykn karoora dhiyoof yeroo ammaa salphaa).
n-k-l1h-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Jechi yeroo koo fi xumurri gochaa koo yeroo wal-fakkaataa agarsiisuu?
n-k-l1h-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Himni koo amma illee waa'ee mana kitaabaa deemuu dubbataa?
n-k-l1h-02.s.s3.modelNote.2: Yeroon ammaa salphaan karoora dhiyoof illee fayyadama.

n-k-l1h-03.title: Sa'aatii tokkoo sinimaa irra jiraachuu dandeessaa?
n-k-l1h-03.goal: Affeerraa hiriyaa deebisuu dura dhugaa torban kee barbaachisu murteessi, dhugaan lama walitti ida'amuu qabu hubadhu, fi Afaan Koriyaatiin deebisi.
n-k-l1h-03.material:
Hiriyaan kee Jina ergaa siif erga.

지나: 토요일 한 시에 영화를 봐요. 같이 가요?

Torban kee ilaalta. Kunniin wanta ati beektu:

- 토요일 수업이 오전 아홉 시에 시작해요.
- 토요일 수업이 열두 시에 끝나요.
- 학교에서 영화관까지 삼십 분 걸려요.
- 일요일 저녁에 가족 식사가 있어요.
- 월요일부터 금요일까지 회사에 가요.
n-k-l1h-03.thinking.1: Dhugaa lama walitti ida'uu (yeroo xumuraa + yeroo geejjibaa)
n-k-l1h-03.thinking.2: Dhugaa dhugaa ta'e garuu hin barbaachisne dhiisuu
n-k-l1h-03.prereq.1: Guyyoota torbanii fi yeroo sa'aatii (열두 시, 한 시) ni beeka
n-k-l1h-03.prereq.2: 걸려요 (yeroo fudhata) ni beeka; qajeelfama keessatti ibsameera
n-k-l1h-03.s.s1.prompt: Sanbata sa'aatii tokkoon sinimaa irra jiraachuu dandeessa moo hin dandeessu beekuu barbaadda. Dhugaan kamtu si barbaachisa? Dhugaa si barbaachisu hunda mallatteessi. (삼십 분 = daqiiqaa 30)
n-k-l1h-03.s.s1.hint.0: Yeroo kutaan xumuramu mana barumsaa irra jirta jedhii yaadi. Yoom akka ga'u jechuuf wantoota lama maal beekuu qabda?
n-k-l1h-03.s.s1.hint.2: Dhugaa tokko tokkoof gaafadhu: yoom bilisa akka ta'e ykn karaan hangam akka fudhatu naaf hima?
n-k-l1h-03.s.s1.r.a: Yeroon kutaan itti jalqabu yeroo ati bilisa taatu hin jijjiiru. Dhugaa waa'ee xumura kutaa fi karaa sinimaa barbaadi.
n-k-l1h-03.s.s1.r.d: Dilbata guyyaa biraa dha. Sanbata sa'aatii tokko hin jijjiiru.
n-k-l1h-03.s.s1.r.e: Wiixata hanga Jimaata guyyoota biroo dha. Sanbata hin jijjiiru.
n-k-l1h-03.s.s1.explain: Yeroo bilisa taatu (kutaan 12:00 irratti xumurama) fi yeroo achi ga'uuf barbaaddu (daqiiqaa 30) si barbaachisa. Tokko isaanii qofaan murteessuu hin dandeessu. Dhugaan sadan kaan dhugaa dha, garuu waa'ee yeroo biroo dha.
n-k-l1h-03.s.s2.prompt: Amma dhugaa kee lamaan fayyadami. Sa'aatii tokkoon sinimaa irra jiraachuu dandeessaa?
n-k-l1h-03.s.s2.hint.0: Xumura kutaa irraa jalqabi fi yeroo geejjibaa dabali.
n-k-l1h-03.s.s2.hint.1: Yeroo ga'umsaa yeroo fiilmii waliin wal-bira qabi.
n-k-l1h-03.s.s2.o.a: Lakkii. Mana barumsaa 12:30 dura ba'uu qabda, garuu kutaan 12 irratti xumurama, kanaaf si turfateera.
n-k-l1h-03.s.s2.r.a: 12:00 irratti ba'uun 12:30 caalaa dursa, kanaaf hin turfattu; yeroo hafe qabda.
n-k-l1h-03.s.s2.o.b: Lakkii. 1:30 irratti ga'ta, sababni 12:00 + daqiiqaa 30 1:30 dha.
n-k-l1h-03.s.s2.o.c: Eyyee. 12:30 irratti ga'ta, sa'aatii tokko dura.
n-k-l1h-03.s.s2.o.d: Beekuu hin dandeenyu. Fiilmiin hangam akka tures beekuu qabna.
n-k-l1h-03.s.s2.r.d: Dheerinni fiilmii yoom akka xumuramu waliin wal-qaba, yeroo ga'umsaa waliin miti.
n-k-l1h-03.s.s2.explain: Kutaan 12:00 irratti xumurama. Karaan daqiiqaa 30 fudhata. Kanaaf 12:30 irratti ga'ta, fiilmii daqiiqaa 30 dura.
n-k-l1h-03.s.s3.prompt: Jina Afaan Koriyaa ulfinaa gabaabaatiin deebisi: dhufuu akka dandeessu fi yeroo ga'u himi (ykn sa'aatii tokko dura achi akka jiraattu).
n-k-l1h-03.s.s3.hint.1: Yeroo ga'umsaa sa'aatii 시 (fi walakkaa 반) fayyadamuun dabali.
n-k-l1h-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Yeroon ga'umsaa koo sa'aatii tokko dura dhaa?

n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.hint.0: Wanta hanga ammaa dubbiste qofa fayyadamuun murteessi.
n-k-l1h-04.title: Sa'aatii torba: ganama moo galgala?
n-k-l1h-04.goal: Ergaawwan gabaabaa sadii hordofi, 'sa'aatii torba' tarkaanfii hundaatti baay'ee maal jechuu danda'a jedhi, fi odeeffannoon haaraan yeroo dhufu dubbisa kee fooyyessi. Ergasii deebii shakkii baasu barreessi.
n-k-l1h-04.material: Ati fi hiriyaan kee Sujin wal-argachuuf karoorfattu. Ergaa ishee tokko tokkoon dubbista.
n-k-l1h-04.thinking.1: Odeeffannoo haaraan yeroo dhufu dubbisa fooyyessuu
n-k-l1h-04.thinking.2: Ergaa mataa kee dogoggoramuu hin dandeenye godhuu
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.prompt: Ergaa tokko tokkoo dubbisi, dubbisa wanta amma beektu waliin simatu filadhu, ergasii itti fufi.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.hint.2: Odeeffannoon haaraan yeroo dhufu, dubbisa tokko deggaruu moo ta'uu danda'u qofa caalaatti godha gaafadhu.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ergaan guyyaa (boru) fi sa'aatii (torba) maqaa moggaasa, garuu ganama moo galgala ta'uu hin jedhu. Dubbisni lamaanuu ni danda'ama.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Boru sa'aatii torba, garuu ganama moo galgala ta'uu amma illee ifa miti.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ergaan keessatti ganama hin jedhu. Tilmaama dha.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ergaan keessatti galgala hin jedhu. Tilmaama dha.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: 내일 boru jechuu dha, har'a miti.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Ganama dafee ka'uun walga'ii ganamaa xiqqoo ta'uu danda'u godha, garuu amalli karoora hin murteessu. Xiqqoo mirkanaa'uu dhabuun madaalamaa dha.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ganama ta'uu danda'a, sababni dafee ka'aaf, garuu mirkanaa'ee hin jiru.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Mirkanaa'ee ganama, sababni ja'a irratti ka'uuf.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Isheen dafee ka'a, garuu kun amala dha. Yeroo walga'ii hin jedhu.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Mirkanaa'ee galgala, sababni torba booda dha.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Amma illee ifa miti; ergaan haaraan isaan gidduu hin murteessu.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.st.2.after: 저녁 nyaata galgalaa dha, kanaaf sa'aatii torba galgala sa'aatii torba dha. Odeeffannoon haaraan tilmaama kee jalqabaa bakka buuse.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Boru galgala sa'aatii torba, mana nyaataa fuula dura mana barumsaa.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Boru ganama sa'aatii torba, mana nyaataa fuula dura mana barumsaa.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: 저녁 nyaata galgalaa/galgala jechuu dha. Ganama sa'aatii torba 저녁 hin nyaattu.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Guyyaan ergaa jalqabaa irraa amma illee 내일 dha.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Amma illee ifa miti; ganamaa fi galgalli lamaanuu ni danda'ama.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Waliin 저녁 nyaachuun galgala ta'uu isaa murteessa.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s1.reflect: Yeroon akka 일곱 시 ganama ykn galgala ta'uu danda'a. Dubbisni jalqabaa madaalamaa ture odeeffannoo haaraan baay'ee ykn xiqqaa ta'uu danda'a, fi amalli (아침에 일찍 일어나요) karoora (저녁을 같이 먹어요) caalaa ragaa laafaa dha.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s2.prompt: Kutaan ergaa dhumaa kamtu gaaffii sana murteesse?
n-k-l1h-04.s.s2.hint.1: Jechoota eessa ykn eenyu waliin jedhan qofa bututi.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s2.r.b: Manni nyaataa ganama illee banamuu danda'a, kanaaf iddoon hin murteessu.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s2.r.c: 같이 'waliin' jechuu dha. Waa'ee namoota dha, yeroo miti.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s2.explain: 저녁 kutaa guyyaa (fi nyaata) maqaa moggaasa. Jechoonni kaan iddoo ykn hiriyaa kennu.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s3.prompt: Ergaa jalqabaa Sujin ('내일 일곱 시에 만나요.') ulfinaan deebiin gabaabaa shakkii yeroo baasu barreessi. Gaaffii ykn ibsi sirrii dha.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s3.hint.0: Jecha tokko 일곱 시 tti dabaluu qabdu maali?
n-k-l1h-04.s.s3.hint.1: Jechoota kutaa guyyaa: 아침, 오전, 오후, 저녁, 밤.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s3.hint.2: Gaaffii gaafachuu ykn yeroo mirkaneessuu dandeessa.
n-k-l1h-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Deebiin koo jecha ganamaa ykn galgalaa qabaa?
n-k-l1h-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Sujin yoom akka dhufu sirriitti beekuu danda'aa?

n-k-l1h-05.title: Yeroo garee qo'annoo
n-k-l1h-05.goal: Ergaa gabaabaa hiriyoota irraa afur gara haala sirriitti jijjiiri, filannoo guyyaa-fi-yeroo adda addaa sadii haalawwan hundumaa guutan argi, fi karoora Afaan Koriyaatiin barreessi.
n-k-l1h-05.material:
Hiriyoonni afur torbaan tokko Afaan Koriyaa qo'achuuf wal-argu. Booda guyyaa sa'aatii lama qo'atu.

민호: 월요일하고 금요일에는 일해요.
지아: 토요일 오전에는 수영해요. 일요일에는 안 와요.
수아: 오후 세 시 전에는 안 돼요. 여섯 시에는 집에 가요.
유나: 수요일 오후 네 시에 한국어 수업이 있어요.

(Monday = 월요일, Tuesday = 화요일, Wednesday = 수요일, Thursday = 목요일, Friday = 금요일, Saturday = 토요일, Sunday = 일요일)
(안 와요 = hin dhufu, 안 돼요 = hin danda'amu, 전 = dura)
n-k-l1h-05.thinking.1: Haala haala biraa dhoksu (yeroo xumuraa yeroo jalqabaa irraa)
n-k-l1h-05.thinking.2: Haala hin barbaachisne (daakuu ganamaa vs walga'ii booda guyyaa)
n-k-l1h-05.prereq.1: Guyyoota torbanii, sa'aatii lammummaa (세 시, 네 시) fi 두 시간 ni beeka
n-k-l1h-05.prereq.2: 오전 (guyyaa walakkaa dura) fi 오후 (guyyaa walakkaa booda) ni beeka
n-k-l1h-05.s.s1.prompt: 수아 '여섯 시에는 집에 가요.' jetti. Yeroon qo'annoo sa'aatii lama. Yeroon jalqabaa isa dhumaa isa hojjetu kami?
n-k-l1h-05.s.s1.hint.0: Yeroo jalqabaa danda'amu irraa sa'aatii lama dabali.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s1.hint.1: Yeroon qo'annoo yeroo ishee ba'u irraa dura xumuramuu qaba.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s1.r.a: Shan irratti yoo jalqabde, torba tti qo'ata. 수아 ja'a irratti mana deemteetti.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s1.r.c: Sadi isheen dhufuu danda'u dura dha, isa dhumaa miti. Jalqabni booda illee hojjetu danda'a.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s1.r.d: Ja'a irratti jalqabuun isheen erga ba'ee booda dha.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s1.explain: Afur irraa sa'aatii lama ja'a irratti xumurama, yeroo isheen mana deemtu. Jalqabni booda ja'a booda xumurama.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.prompt: Filannoo adda addaa 3 (guyyaa fi yeroo jalqabaa) hiriyoota afran hundaaf simatu argi. d = guyyaa (1 = Wiixata, 2 = Kibxata, 3 = Roobii, 4 = Kamisa, 5 = Jimaata, 6 = Sanbata, 7 = Dilbata). h = sa'aatii jalqabaa booda guyyaa (3 = 오후 세 시).
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.hint.0: Dura guyyoota guutuu bututi, ergasii sa'aatii hojjedhu.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.hint.1: Hima hiriyaa hundi deebii kee jijjiiruu hin qabu: booda guyyaa tuqu moo hin tuqne gaafadhu.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.hint.2: Guyyoonni tokko tokko sa'aatii murtaa'e irratti daangaa qabu. Guyyaa hin bututamne tokko tokkoof, sa'aatii lama kee daangaa hundumaa waliin mirkaneessi.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.ok.c0: Guyyaa dhugaa fi sa'aatii booda guyyaa guutuu.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.fail.c0: Lakkoofsa guyyaa 1 irraa 7 fi sa'aatii booda guyyaa guutuu fayyadami.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.fail.c3: 수아 sa'aatii sadi dura dhufuu hin dandeessu.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.fail.c4: Sa'aatiiwwan lamaan ja'a dura xumuramuu qabu, yeroo 수아 mana deemtu.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.ok.c5: Kutaa Yuna waliin wal-faallessuu hin jiru.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.fail.c5: Roobii 유나 afur irratti kutaa qabdi, kunis sa'aatii lama kee waliin wal-faallessa.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.explain: Guyyoonni danda'aman: Kibxata, Kamisa, Sanbata (Wiixata fi Jimaata hafaniiru, Dilbata hafeera, Roobiin kutaa waliin wal-faallessa). Jalqabni danda'amu: sa'aatii sadi ykn afur. Daakuun ganamaa Jia Sanbata irratti hin dhimmu sababni walga'iin booda guyyaa dha. Kunis filannoo ja'a kenna; kamiyyuu sadan gaarii dha.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Filannoo kee keessaa TOKKO filadhu fi karoora garee tiif Afaan Koriyaatiin guyyaa, 오후 fi sa'aatii waliin barreessi.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sarara tokko tarree kee irraa fayyadami: guyyaa kam, sa'aatii kam?
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Qajeelfama: guyyaa + 오후 + sa'aatii + 시에 만나요.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Guyyaan koo Kibxata, Kamisa ykn Sanbata keessaa tokko dhaa?
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Sa'aatiin koo booda guyyaa sadi ykn afur dhaa?

n-k-l1e-05.prereq.0: Hangul fi batchim dubbisuu ni danda'a
n-k-l1e-05.s.s1.prompt: Maqaan kee 벤 dha (qubee-sagalee-hin-taaneen xumurama, ㄴ). 'Ani Ben' akkamitti jetta?

n-k-l1e-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Barreeffamni koo maqaa, biyya, fi hojii kenna?
